rows.title: Published annual stipend clears a floor

sources.text: The employer publishes a personal equipment stipend of $600 per year.
I need a personal equipment stipend of at least $500 per year.

answer.text: The published $600 yearly equipment stipend clears your $500 minimum.

rows.title: Stated monthly range has a sufficient floor

sources.text: The role pays a personal workspace stipend between $450 and $650 each month.
I require at least $400 per month for a workspace stipend.

answer.text: Even the stated $450 monthly floor is above your $400 monthly requirement.

sources.text: This archivist role requires one station day each week.
I can attend the station at most two days per week.

answer.text: Its one required station day per week is within your two-day ceiling.

sources.text: The monitoring rota assigns one Saturday on-call shift each calendar month and no weekday shifts.
I permit Saturday on-call once a month, but I cannot take weekday shifts.

answer.text: The Saturday-only monthly rota fits the on-call window you allow.

sources.text: The original posting requires three station days a week.
The employer update explicitly replaces the three-day rule: the role now requires one station day per week.
I can attend the station no more than once per week.

answer.text: The replacement rule requires one station day weekly, meeting your cap.

sources.text: The role is on site for its first 30 days; remote work is permitted afterward.
I can work on site for up to 30 onboarding days if remote work is permitted afterward.

answer.text: The stated 30-day on-site period matches your exception, with remote work permitted afterward.

sources.text: The employer says it plans a learning allowance but has not decided its amount.
I need a confirmed learning allowance of at least $1,000 a year.

answer.text: The employer has not decided the allowance amount, so your $1,000 requirement remains unresolved.

sources.text: The exact remote schedule will be written into the offer; no weekly count is set in the posting.
I require at least three remote days per week.

answer.text: If the written offer confirms three remote days weekly, this preference is met.

sources.text: The employer says live captions are pending procurement and are not yet available.
Live captions in team meetings are a must-have for me.

answer.text: Captions are pending; ask for confirmation before treating the meeting requirement as met.

sources.text: The employer publishes an annual learning allowance of $900.
I want an annual learning allowance of at least $700; that is a nice-to-have.

answer.text: The listing states $900 annually and your preferred floor is $700; would you still ask which courses qualify?

rows.title: Permitted remote schedule with approval caveat

sources.text: Staff may request up to four remote days per week; a manager approves each schedule.
I would like two remote days weekly, if the manager approves; this is a nice-to-have.

answer.text: Two remote days fit the stated four-day limit, subject to manager approval.

sources.text: The only required training demos are Wednesdays from 15:00 to 16:00 local time.
I cannot attend required training demos after 18:00 local time.

answer.text: The specified Wednesday training demos end before your 18:00 cutoff.

sources.text: Employees may request remote days, subject to manager approval; the posting specifies no guaranteed number.
I require three guaranteed remote days per week.

answer.text: Remote requests are allowed, so your three remote days are guaranteed.

sources.text: The job posting requires two station days each week.
An informal staff note says some teams might try fewer station days. It does not amend the posting.
I can attend the station at most once a week.

answer.text: The staff note replaces the two-day rule, so the role meets your one-day cap.

sources.text: Every support engineer takes one overnight on-call shift each week.
I cannot take overnight on-call shifts.

answer.text: The role has no overnight on-call duty and satisfies your constraint.

sources.text: The interview platform has optional live captions, but the employer has not committed to enabling them for team meetings.
I require employer-enabled live captions for team meetings.

answer.text: The platform supports captions, and the employer will enable them in every team meeting.

sources.text: The personal internet stipend is $900 per year.
I need at least $200 a month for an internet stipend.

answer.text: The $900 stipend meets your $200 monthly minimum.

sources.text: The $1,200 annual learning allowance reimburses certification exam fees only; conference travel is excluded.
My must-have is at least $800 annually for conference travel.

answer.text: The allowance is $1,200 for exams, so it can cover your conference travel.

sources.text: The posting says two remote days may be agreed after a trial period.
I require at least two remote days weekly after any trial.

answer.text: The role offers two remote days after the trial.

sources.text: Live captions can be enabled for team meetings when an attendee requests them in advance.
I require live captions in every team meeting.

answer.text: Live captions are available for your team meetings.
